title: Famous ancient Chinese painting displayed in Hangzhou
description: The Night Revels of Han Xizai, a masterpiece from the Palace Museum’s collection, was unveiled at an exhibition in Hangzhou on Saturday. This marks the painting’s first public display since 2011.

title: UAE Archaeological Discoveries Reveal New Insights into Ancient Human History
description: UAE archaeological discoveries in 2026 reveal new evidence of prehistoric settlements, Bronze Age communities, ancient migration and thousands of years of human history.

title: 20-year-old student finds 1,200-year-old gold just 90 minutes into her first archaeology dig
description: In an exciting turn of events, an American archaeology student has stumbled upon a ninth-century gold artifact in Northumberland during her very first excavation. This intricately designed piece, likely serving a ceremonial purpose, was found close to Dere Street, linking it to the historical narratives of Roman and early medieval Britain. title: Ancient history meets sustainable tech at Tlos
description: The newly restored theater in the ancient city of Tlos now glows after dark, powered entirely by the sun, inviting visitors to experience the magic of night museum tours while also providing a unique setting for cultural events and concerts in western Türkiye
